title: Paper cutout
line: Layers of cut paper with real drop shadows slide in with parallax and a slight stop-motion step; friendly, handmade, warm.
bestFor: a journey or a plan over time

beats.visual: Four layers of cut-paper hills slide up one after another with parallax; a paper sun pops behind them.
A paper strip with PLAN YOUR WEEK drops in; a dashed paper path winds over the hills with three flags.
The flags pop up one by one along the path; the layers sway slightly on twos.
